steps.content: You turn off the stove and ladle the red bean soup into a bowl. As you turn to carry it out, you see Angell, who has appeared at the kitchen door at some point.
She leans against the door frame and quietly watches you. Seems like she has been standing there for a very long time.
You don't remember her ever doing this before.
Your attempt to tease her feels a bit forced, but she looks away and answers you.
She steps aside to let you through, her voice as calm as ever.

After practicing over these days, your culinary skills have significantly improved. The heat control is just right, making the soup thick and fragrant. A spoonful brings out the delicate sweetness of the red beans.
Angell is concentrated on eating, her face obscured by the white steam rising from the bowl.
Through the veil of steam, you can't see her expression clearly, but you can tell she's carefully savoring the red bean soup.
She takes her time with each spoon, slowly savoring it on her tongue before swallowing it. It's almost like she wants to remember the taste of this soup forever.
You both sit in silence, as if trying to etch this moment into your memory using all your senses. One spoonful after another, she finishes the entire bowl of red bean soup.
She places the spoon back in the bowl and finally lifts her head up.

steps.speaker: Angell
steps.content: I'm taking a day off tomorrow. You're going back to the MBCC, right? I'll give you a ride.
